sentences.text: Seth Woodbury MacFarlane -LRB- -LSB- ˈsɛθ_ˈwʊdbɛri_məkˈfɑrlɪn -RSB- born October 26 , 1973 -RRB- is an American actor , filmmaker , and singer , working primarily in animation and comedy , as well as live-action and other genres .
MacFarlane is the creator of the TV series Family Guy -LRB- 1999 -- 2003 , 2005 -- present -RRB- , co-creator of the TV series American Dad !	Family Guy	Family Guy
-LRB- 2005 -- present -RRB- and The Cleveland Show -LRB- 2009 -- 13 -RRB- .	The Cleveland Show	The Cleveland Show

He also wrote , directed , and starred in the films Ted -LRB- 2012 -RRB- , its sequel Ted 2 -LRB- 2015 -RRB- , and A Million Ways to Die in the West -LRB- 2014 -RRB- .	Ted	Ted (film)	Ted 2	Ted 2	A Million Ways to Die in the West	A Million Ways to Die in the West
MacFarlane is a graduate of the Rhode Island School of Design , where he studied animation .	Rhode Island School of Design	Rhode Island School of Design

Recruited to Hollywood , he was an animator and writer for Hanna-Barbera for several television series , including Johnny Bravo , Cow and Chicken , Dexter 's Laboratory , I Am Weasel , and Larry & Steve .	Hanna-Barbera	Hanna-Barbera	Johnny Bravo	Johnny Bravo	Cow and Chicken	Cow and Chicken	I Am Weasel	I Am Weasel	Larry & Steve	The Life of Larry and Larry & Steve

As an actor , he has made guest appearances on series , such as Gilmore Girls , The War at Home and FlashForward .	Gilmore Girls	Gilmore Girls	The War at Home	The War at Home (TV series)	FlashForward	FlashForward
In 2008 , he created his own YouTube series titled Seth MacFarlane 's Cavalcade of Cartoon Comedy .	YouTube	YouTube
He won several awards for his work on Family Guy , including two Primetime Emmy Awards and an Annie Award .	Family Guy	Family Guy	Primetime Emmy Awards	Primetime Emmy Awards	Annie Award	Annie Award
In 2009 , he won the Webby Award for Film & Video Person of the Year .	Webby Award	Webby Awards
He occasionally speaks at universities and colleges throughout the United States , and he is a supporter of gay rights .	gay rights	LGBT rights by country or territory

MacFarlane 's first feature-length comedy film , Ted , features his voice acting and performance-capture as the titular anthropomorphic teddy bear and became the highest-grossing original R-rated comedy .	Ted	Ted (film)
As a singer MacFarlane has performed at several venues , including Carnegie Hall and the Royal Albert Hall .	Carnegie Hall	Carnegie Hall	Royal Albert Hall	Royal Albert Hall

MacFarlane has released three studio albums , in the same vein of his musical idol Frank Sinatra , beginning with Music Is Better Than Words in 2011 .	Frank Sinatra	Frank Sinatra	Music Is Better Than Words	Music Is Better Than Words

He wrote the lyrics for the Academy Award-nominated song `` Everybody Needs a Best Friend '' for Ted .	Ted	Ted (film)	Academy Award-nominated song	Academy Award for Best Original Song	Everybody Needs a Best Friend	Everybody Needs a Best Friend

MacFarlane served as executive producer of Cosmos : A Spacetime Odyssey , an update of the 1980s Carl Sagan -- hosted Cosmos series , hosted by Neil deGrasse Tyson .	executive producer	executive producer	Carl Sagan	Carl Sagan	Neil deGrasse Tyson	Neil deGrasse Tyson
MacFarlane was instrumental in providing funding for the series , as well as securing studio support for it from other entertainment executives .
